tool_signatures.name: run_workflow
tool_signatures.description: Run a deployed workflow once, for real, with an optional JSON payload as its trigger input, and return what happened. A simple workflow answers with its HTTP status, duration and response body. A durable one (with a wait, delay, approval or sub-workflow) starts a run and returns its instanceId and status: follow it with get_run. Use it after deploying to show the user a real result. It runs in the user

tool_signatures.name: validate_workflow
tool_signatures.description: Compile a workflow without deploying it and report every error, each with the node it concerns. Use it after every edit and before deploy_workflow. Checks the saved graph by workflowId, or an unsaved graph passed as nodes and edges (given with a workflowId, they replace the saved ones for this check only). Set includeCode to also get the generated Worker script and its metadata (target, bindings, size) to show the user.

tool_signatures.name: verify_connection
tool_signatures.description: Check a saved connection against its provider right now (a read-only identity call) and record the result. Use it when a node fails with what looks like an authentication error: access that worked when it was saved may since have been revoked or narrowed. Returns the connection
